title: Delivery Address Change Limits: Delivery & Pickup Appointments Terms
content:
On a delivered appointment, the delivery address can be changed only within the limits below. They are set for each fulfillment method of Delivery & Pickup Appointments.

| Fulfillment method | Hours before the window start after which the address can no longer be changed | Greatest distance between the original and new address for a change without re-quoting the fee |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | 0 (not a delivery method) | 0 miles |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | 0 (not a delivery method) | 0 miles |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | 0 (not a delivery method) | 0 miles |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | 48 hours | 25 miles |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | 72 hours | 50 miles |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | 96 hours | 50 miles |

**Cutoff.** For the delivered methods the cutoff runs backwards from the start of the booked window. A Local Home Delivery address can be changed up to 48 hours before the window opens, an Extended-Zone Delivery address up to 72 hours before, and an Enclosed White-Glove Delivery address up to 96 hours before. After the cutoff the address can no longer be changed.

**Distance.** The new address may be up to 25 miles from the original address under Local Home Delivery, and up to 50 miles under the other two delivered methods.

**Pickup methods.** A cutoff of 0 marks a method that is not a delivery method. Hub Pickup, Vending Tower Pickup and Fly & Drive carry 0 for both figures.
